learn
學
What would you like to learn from someone in your family?
I would like to learn how my aunt grows vegetables. Working beside her would help me understand more than watching a video.
我想跟阿姨學種菜。和她一起動手，比只看影片更容易弄懂。
study
讀書
Where would you study if your home became too distracting?
I would study at a nearby library. Leaving my chores behind would make it easier to focus for an hour.
我會去附近圖書館讀書。暫時離開家事，比較能專心一個小時。
school
學校
If you could change one thing about your school, what would it be?
I would give the school more spaces for small group discussions. Not every useful lesson needs a large classroom.
我會讓學校多一些小組討論空間。有用的課程，不一定都要在大教室裡進行。
student
學生
What advice would you give a student joining a class halfway through the term?
I would tell the student to borrow a classmate's notes first. A friendly classmate could also explain the class routines and upcoming tests.
我會建議那位學生先跟同學借筆記。熱心的同學也能說明班上的規矩和接下來的考試。
teach
教
How would you teach a friend a skill you already know?
I would teach one small step and let my friend try it. Watching the attempt would show me what to explain next.
我會先教一個小步驟，讓朋友自己試。看過他怎麼做，再決定接下來要說明什麼。
subject
科目
Which subject would you like to revisit as an adult?
Geography is a subject I would like to study again. Understanding maps and climate would make the places I visit more interesting.
地理是我想重新學習的科目。了解地圖和氣候，旅行時看到的地方也會更有意思。
course
課程
What would make you choose an evening course rather than study alone?
I would choose a course that offered useful feedback. Regular discussion would help me notice mistakes I might miss alone.
如果課程能提供實用回饋，我就會考慮報名。固定討論，能幫我發現自己沒注意到的錯誤。
lesson
教訓
What lesson did you learn from a plan that went wrong?
Missing a train taught me a useful lesson about leaving extra time. Now I check the route before setting out.
錯過火車讓我學到一個教訓：出門要多留時間。現在出發前，我都會先查好路線。
exam
考試
How would you prepare for an exam with both essays and short questions?
I would practise both formats before the exam. Knowing the material would not be enough if I could not organize an answer.
考試前，我會練習兩種題型。光懂內容還不夠，也要能把答案整理清楚。
knowledge
知識
How can you tell whether you can use new knowledge in practice?
I test my knowledge by explaining it through a new example. If I cannot do that, I need to revisit the idea.
我會試著用新例子解釋剛學的知識。如果做不到，就表示還需要回頭弄懂。
understand
理解
What do you do when an explanation sounds clear but you still cannot apply it?
I ask for a concrete example to understand the steps. Then I try a similar problem without copying the solution.
我會請對方舉個具體例子，幫助理解步驟。再試著做類似的題目，不照抄解法。
explain
解釋
How would you explain a technical idea to someone new to the topic?
I would explain it using an everyday comparison first. After checking their understanding, I would introduce the more precise terms.
我會先用日常的比喻解釋。確認對方聽懂後，再介紹比較精確的用語。
practice
練習
How would you fit regular practice into a busy week?
I would attach ten minutes of practice to an existing routine. A short session I can repeat beats an ambitious plan I abandon.
我會在原有作息裡加上十分鐘練習。能持續的小安排，比做不到的大計畫有用。
review
複習
How would you review material a week after learning it?
I would review by answering questions before opening my notes. The gaps would tell me which parts deserved more attention.
我會先試著答題，再翻筆記複習。答不出來的地方，就是需要多花時間的部分。
memory
記憶
What helps you keep an unfamiliar name in your memory?
I connect the name with a clear image in my memory. Repeating it naturally during the conversation also helps.
我會在記憶裡，把名字和清楚的畫面連起來。聊天時自然地再叫一次，也比較記得住。
concentrate
專心
How would you concentrate when messages keep arriving on your phone?
I would put my phone out of reach to concentrate. I could check messages at the end of a planned study block.
我會把手機放遠一點，讓自己專心。等安排好的讀書時段結束，再看訊息。
attention
注意力
What helps you bring your attention back when a long class starts to feel boring?
A brief question would bring my attention back to the topic. I would write down one point I still wanted to understand.
問一個簡短問題，能讓我的注意力回到課程。我也會寫下還沒弄懂的一個重點。
method
方法
How would you decide whether a new study method works for you?
I would try the method on a small section first. Later, I would check what I remembered without looking at the notes.
我會先用一小段內容試試這個方法。過一陣子不看筆記，檢查自己還記得多少。
progress
進步
How could you notice progress that feels too slow to see day by day?
I would compare my current work with something from a month ago. Small daily changes can add up to visible progress.
我會把現在的成果和一個月前相比。每天一點點的變化，累積起來就是看得見的進步。
goal
目標
What makes a learning goal realistic rather than discouraging?
A realistic goal describes something I can practise regularly. I would start with one short conversation rather than promise instant fluency.
實際的目標，要是我能固定練習的事情。我會先求能聊一小段，不要求自己立刻流利。
question
問題
What would you do if you felt embarrassed to ask a question in class?
I would write my question down and ask after class. Getting an answer matters more than pretending I already understand.
我會先寫下問題，下課後再問。弄懂答案，比假裝自己聽懂重要。
answer
答案
How would you check an answer that seems correct but feels uncertain?
I would check the answer using a different example. If the same reasoning failed there, I would examine my assumptions.
我會換個例子檢查答案。如果同樣的推理不成立，就回頭看看原本的假設。
reason
原因
How would you investigate the reason you keep making the same mistake?
I would look for the reason by comparing several attempts. The problem might be a missed step rather than a lack of effort.
我會比較幾次作答，找出一直出錯的原因。可能只是漏了一個步驟，不是不夠努力。
evidence
證據
What evidence would convince you that a learning app is helping?
I would want evidence that I could remember and use material later. A high score immediately after practice would not be enough.
我想看到過一陣子還記得、也用得出來的證據。剛練完拿高分，還不足以說明有效。
